LanguageData.FE_AssignAdoptiveParentText: {CHILD_labelShort} has joined the colony. Choose an adult colonist to be recognized as {CHILD_possessive} adoptive parent.
LanguageData.FE_OrphanAdoptionLetterText: {CHILD_labelShort} has no living recognized parent. Choose an adult colonist to become {CHILD_possessive} adoptive parent.
LanguageData.FE_AssignFosterParentText: {CHILD_labelShort} is staying with the colony as a foster child. Choose an adult colonist to be recognized as {CHILD_possessive} foster parent.
LanguageData.FE_FamilyIsEverythingAlreadyPlaced: {CHILD_labelShort} already has an adoptive or foster parent.
LanguageData.FE_AdoptionPlacementLetterText: A message arrives from {FACTION}. Their settlement is under attack. They can only save one child. They ask your colony to take the baby immediately and raise them as one of your own.
LanguageData.FE_FosterPlacementLetterText: {FACTION} asks your colony to care for a child until adulthood. When the child turns 18, they will expect you to return the child home.
LanguageData.FE_AdoptiveChildArrived: A drop pod carrying {CHILD_labelShort} is incoming.
LanguageData.FE_FosterChildArrived: A drop pod carrying {CHILD_labelShort} is incoming for foster care.
LanguageData.FE_FamilyPlacementFailed: The placement could not be completed.
LanguageData.FE_FosterResolutionLetterText: {CHILD_labelShort} has reached adulthood. {FACTION} expects the foster stay to end. Return {CHILD_objective} within three days, or the colony will adopt {CHILD_objective}. If {CHILD_labelShort} is away when the deadline passes, adoption will complete on returning to a colony home map.\n\nAdoption breaks the foster agreement. Goodwill with {FACTION}: -60.
LanguageData.FE_FosterReturnExpired: The foster review deadline has passed. Adoption is pending.
LanguageData.FE_FosterNeedsHome: The pawn must be on a colony home map to resolve the foster stay.
LanguageData.FE_FosterSourceMissing: The original settlement is unavailable. Adoption is still possible.
LanguageData.FE_FosterChildAdopted: {CHILD_labelShort} has been adopted into the colony.
LanguageData.FE_FosterReturnRewardQuestDescription: {CHILD_labelShort}'s foster stay is complete, and {FACTION} has sent thanks for returning {CHILD_objective} home. Choose one reward shipment.
LanguageData.FE_FosterReturnRewardLetterText: {FACTION} has offered a reward for the successful return of {CHILD_labelShort}. Choose one reward option in the quest tab.
LanguageData.FE_FosterReturnRewardArrivedLetterText: The selected foster reward has arrived by transport pod.
LanguageData.FE_FosterChildKeptAngerLetterText: {FACTION} is furious that your colony refused to return {CHILD_labelShort}. They consider this a grave betrayal of the foster agreement.\n\nGoodwill with {FACTION}: -60.
